settings.title: YOUR DANCE FLOOR READY IN MINUTES!
settings.text: Add edge pieces to your order and complete your dancefloor

In four simple and fast steps, you can have your surface fully installed in minutes or less.

Getting Started

The panels have two sides with female PowerLocks, and two sides with male PowerLocks. All tiles on any given installation should always have the female PowerLocks going in the same direction.

Step One

Begin the installation by laying down your first panel in any one corner and pointing the female PowerLocks in the two directions that additional panels are to be added.

Step Two

Place the next panel so that the male PowerLock line up over the top of the female loops on the first panel. It's important to make sure that the female PowerLocks are facing exactly the same direction as the first panel.

Step Three

Gently step along the joint of the two panels. You will hear and feel the PowerLocks snap into place as you go.

Step Four

Once the two panels are joined, repeat steps one through three remembering to keep the female PowerLocks aligned until your floor is complete. That's all there is to this easy-to-install flooring!

settings.title: Step One
settings.text: Start by placing your first dance floor panel in a corner, with the female PowerLocks facing the two directions where additional panels will be added.

settings.title: Step two
settings.text: Position the next panel so the male PowerLocks align over the female loops of the first panel. Ensure that all female PowerLocks are facing the same direction.

settings.title: Step Three
settings.text: Step gently along the joint of the two panels until you hear and feel the PowerLocks snap securely into place.

settings.title: Step Four
settings.text:
Continue repeating Steps 1–3, keeping the female PowerLocks aligned, until your dance floor installation is complete.

That’s all there is to this easy-to-install flooring!

settings.title: Can these dance floor tiles be used outdoors?
settings.text: Yes. Our Event and Dance Floor Interlocking Tiles are designed for both indoor and outdoor use. However, please note that they cannot be placed directly on grass or sand without a subcompact base or a hard surface underneath. This ensures stability and prevents damage.

settings.title: Are the tiles easy to install?
settings.text: Absolutely. The interlocking PowerLock™ system allows tool-free installation. Simply snap the tiles together, and you’ll have a seamless dance floor in minutes.

settings.title: How many tiles do I need for my event?
settings.text: We recommend allowing 3 square feet per person when planning your dance floor size. You can easily calculate the total area based on your guest count.

settings.title: Can I use these tiles in a dance studio?
settings.text: Yes. These tiles are perfect for temporary or permanent setups in dance studios, fitness studios, and event venues. They provide a safe, high-traction surface suitable for all types of dance routines.

settings.title: How should I store the dance floor tiles after use?
settings.text: For long-lasting performance, store the tiles horizontally indoors in a temperature-controlled environment. Avoid stacking them on their sides to prevent warping or damage.

settings.title: Are the tiles portable?
settings.text: Yes. The lightweight design makes them easy to transport, set up, and take down—ideal for weddings, parties, performances, and traveling events.

settings.title: Do the tiles require special cleaning?
settings.text: No. Simply sweep, mop, or use a damp cloth to clean. The non-porous surface makes maintenance simple and fast.

settings.title: Do you ship across Canada, and how long does delivery take?
settings.text: Yes, we ship nationwide across Canada. Delivery times vary by province, but most orders typically arrive within 5–25 business days.
